result.pairwise_reason: PP012-C provides the most complete, mechanistically coherent, and quantitatively grounded answer, clearly distinguishing each hop with specific biological mechanisms (YAP/TAZ, ROS, HBV integration rates, fibrosis stage thresholds) and acknowledging uncertainties, without the circular reasoning flaw of D or the truncation issue of B.
